long_biography.plain_text:
Puerto Rico Coffee Roasters became a vehicle for Alberto E. de la Cruz's expansion beyond soft drinks. As its chairman and principal shareholder, he was central to the purchase of the Yaucono coffee business. The group subsequently built a portfolio spanning roasted coffee, prepared foods and other everyday products. His current CC1 responsibilities include beverage bottling and a dairy operation added through the acquisition of Suiza's plant and brand.

A Georgetown graduate, de la Cruz and his wife Maria were lead donors to an art gallery at their alma mater. Their gift opened a space for contemporary art exhibitions accessible to students and the wider public. He has also served as president of Coca-Cola Bottling of Trinidad, extending his operating work across the Caribbean.
